in_arabic.name: Mawhab
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mawhab هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A name derived from the Arabic root 'w-h-b' meaning 'to love, to desire'. In the Islamic context, it can be interpreted as having a strong passion for the love of Allah and His teachings.
